values.note: FS: four loops, 44 campsites (29 reservable, 14 electric) plus one group site; maximum RV 60 ft, and wheeled equipment must fit the spur (no overflow parking). Catalog lengths run 14-65 ft; Loop C has several short, sloped spurs (02 15 ft, 07 20 ft 'Severe' slope, 04 27, 11 28).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/junction-creek-campground ('Four camping loops ... with a total of 44 campsites, 29 reservable sites and 14 sites with electrical hook-ups'; 'Max RV size = 60 ft'; 'Equipment with wheels ... must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available') + catalog 234475 (Driveway Entry Pull-Through on Loop E 04 and 06), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 234475 (Electricity Hookup 50 on all 14 Loop E Standard Electric sites, 12 of them reservable) + FS page ('14 sites with electrical hook-ups'), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF campground ~5 mi NW of Durango at ~7,300 ft, on a south-facing ponderosa-and-oak hillside a quarter-mile above Junction Creek, at the Durango end of the Colorado Trail (Junction Creek Trail from camp). Group pavilion with volleyball and horseshoes. Bear country. --Claude
